caption: New wind-combed procedural grass meadow at noon in Harrowmere Vale; bare ground between clumps is still flat grey-brown and the distant hills float as disconnected ribbons in the fog.
Grass on a Vale slope at 16:30 golden hour reads well up close, but past the 64 m grass radius the valley is an empty brown plane under grey sky with no trees, rocks or village.
Noon in Harrowmere Vale: the hill bowl finally renders solid behind the wind-combed meadow (terrain winding fix); still no trees, rocks, village or textures, and the capsule player is a speck.
16:30: long hill shadows sweep across the valley, but the shadowed foreground is crushed to black and the sky is flat grey.
22:30: new moonlight and star field make the night readable on wind-bent grass; no moon disc, fireflies or night life yet.
New procedural black-oak grove backlit at 15:30 with long trunk shadows through the grass; foreground shadow is crushed to black and leaf cards read as blobs up close.
Oak woodland now crowns the vale's hills above the wind-blown meadow at noon; boulders are too small to read, sky is flat and the hill ground is still bare procedural brown.
Backlit oak grove at 15:30: the shadowed grass and trunks now read with cool skylight instead of crushing to black; leaf cards still look like flat blobs up close.
Noon meadow and oak-crowned hills: shade under the grass is readable now; boulders are too small, hill ground is bare procedural brown.
Village edge at 16:30, previously half black: the shadowed meadow is now visible, but the sky is too dark navy for late afternoon and the horizon is empty.
16:30 over the village meadow: the sky is now a deep clear blue instead of navy and the shaded meadow reads; a tree trunk still blocks the left edge and the hills are bare procedural orange.
Noon oak slope under a bright blue sky with readable shadow sides; leaf cards are blobby up close and the valley floor is bare brown.
Noon meadow with oak groves and, new, a hazy snow-capped mountain ring closing the horizon; ridgelines are still faceted at distance and the hills are bare brown.
Late-afternoon view across the vale to layered ranges and snowy peaks; the foreground grass sits in deep shadow and the peaks form a uniform sawtooth.
A rook flock feeding on cropped turf in the vale at 14:00; reads as a real field, but the crop patch shows bare brown ground and the birds are tiny at 15 m.
Rooks bursting up out of the meadow as the camera comes within 10 m; motion reads in a clip, but the still is small dark specks and the shaded hillside is muddy.
The player is now a rigged, animated human instead of a capsule, standing in the afternoon meadow; still wrong: sci-fi armour and visor instead of a mythic hero, no face, hair or staff.
Follow camera on the player mid-stride in the idle/walk/run blend at dusk, lantern glow on the grass; still wrong: placeholder Mixamo soldier model and no foot IK.

Close rear view of the hero's new procedural staff slung across the back: worn bronze caps, red lacquered shaft, hemp-wrapped grip; still wrong: it is strapped to a sci-fi armoured soldier with no strap or scabbard holding it.
The hero seen from behind against a low sun, staff diagonal across the back at body scale; still wrong: placeholder Mixamo soldier model, flat cartoonish far mountains.
